intro:
A user's picture, falling back to initials when there is no source or the image fails to load.

Pass `fallback` with the initials you want; without it, a missing image leaves an empty circle.
usage:
<Avatar size="lg" source={{ uri: user.avatarUrl }} fallback="KA" />

<Avatar source={{ uri: user.avatarUrl }} fallback="KA">
  <Avatar.Badge>
    <Badge variant="destructive" count={5} />
  </Avatar.Badge>
</Avatar>

parts.Badge: Overlay pinned to the top-right — an unread count or a presence dot.

notes: A plain avatar renders as one clipped node. Adding children wraps it in an unclipped container so a corner badge is not cut in half by the circular mask.

examples.title: Image with an initials fallback
examples.description: The fallback shows while the image is missing **and** if it fails to load, so a dead URL never leaves an empty circle.
examples.code:
<Avatar source={{ uri: user.avatarUrl }} fallback="KA" />

{/* No source at all — straight to initials. */}
<Avatar fallback="OL" />

preview.alt: Avatar — Image with an initials fallback.

examples.title: A presence dot
examples.description: `Avatar.Badge` hangs off an unclipped wrapper, so it is not cut in half by the avatar’s rounding.
examples.code:
<Avatar size="lg" source={{ uri: user.avatarUrl }} fallback="KA">
  <Avatar.Badge>
    <View className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-green-500" />
  </Avatar.Badge>
</Avatar>

examples.title: A stack
examples.description: Negative margins overlap them; reverse the row so the first is on top.
examples.code:
<View className="flex-row-reverse justify-end">
  {members.map((member) => (
    <Avatar
      key={member.id}
      size="sm"
      source={{ uri: member.avatarUrl }}
      fallback={member.initials}
      className="-ml-2 border-2 border-background"
    />
  ))}
</View>

examples.title: A notification badge
examples.description: `Avatar.Badge` overlays a `Badge` in the corner — a count, or a `shape="dot"` presence dot.
examples.code:
<Avatar size="lg" source={{ uri: user.avatar }} fallback="AB">
  <Avatar.Badge>
    <Badge variant="destructive" count={5} />
  </Avatar.Badge>
</Avatar>
